problemStatement.formal: For the intrinsic path metric d_path(x,y) defined by an infimum of path lengths, prove d_path(x,z) <= d_path(x,y) + d_path(y,z).
problemStatement.plain: Prove the triangle inequality for path and geodesic distances by concatenating paths and adding their lengths.
whyMatters: Captures the core reason geodesic distances form metrics
Provides a path-metric foundation for future Riemannian formalization

proven: Path length is additive under concatenation.
The intrinsic/path metric satisfies the triangle inequality.
The proof uses total variation splitting and reparameterization invariance.
open: Extend the abstract path-metric result to full Riemannian manifolds once Mathlib support matures.
knownResults.goal: Record the verified path-metric triangle inequality formalization.
